correctness.rationale: The Venn-cell support bits recover all subset/existence atoms, and signs of four linear differences recover every comparison atom. Each permitted support-status pair realizes exactly its allowed B2 arrangement faces (17+28+6+12+4=67). Minima require |u|+|v|+2 per both-positive pair; preserving sign rays/regions while increasing one or two cells proves all ordinary and even tails, and the explicit all-four-positive strict-comparison witness forces seven elements. checker.py independently evaluates all 64 atoms on all 1,819 quadruples of total size 1–12; finite checks corroborate, not substitute for, the proof.

value.rationale: The complete 67-theory classification and sharp seven-element bound quantify a natural minimal two-predicate fragment for which support and cardinality interact. The theorem covers all satisfiable incomplete theories for the model-size cutoff and gives every complete theory spectrum with multiplicities, a substantive invariant not determined by the unrestricted general tail theorem.
